description: Continue QKV unions with recovered accuracy margin
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,617 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000-point margin. There have been 57 prior macro-attempts and 513 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0159/micro-0016 at 1,617/99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0159/micro-0017, where pair 564/572 scored 98.99% at 1,616. Eight measured sensitive pairs are excluded. Hypothesis: the recovered margin plus 16 consecutive prior accepts indicates another ordered band of near-duplicate QKV groups can qualify after skipping the isolated failure. The helper adds one minimum-difference eligible union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than switching family because it continues the run’s strongest recently validated reduction mechanism under slightly improved margin.
summary: The eighth skip-path QKV band evaluated 13 ordered unions. Twelve qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,617 to 1,605 parameters; micro-0013 proposed 1,604 parameters, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 12 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used 13 official migrations/verifications over about 16m20s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap.
